notes.title: Spellagis will be released on October 10!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

[h2]We are pleased to announce that Spellagis will be available on Steam on October 10![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2972090/Spellagis/

[code][h2]Choose Your Path to Victory![/h2]

With over 8 characters at your disposal, each possessing unique starting characteristics, you're offered diverse pathways to triumph. Every character presents a distinct approach to the game, allowing you to adopt your own style and strategy to overcome any obstacles and achieve triumph in this captivating world.

[h2]Unlock New Strategies![/h2]

Over 70 unique artifacts, each bringing its own special advantages. From powerful weapons to magical relics, every item unveils new strategies and tactics for you to explore.

[h2]Winner's Rewards![/h2]

Conquer the arena and earn crystals with each victory to purchase permanent enhancements for your character! Unique skills, attribute upgrades, and powerful artifacts await you in the hidden shop, where every purchase brings you one step closer to your ultimate power. Go ahead, claim your reward, and turn your hero into an unstoppable force on the battlefield![/code]

[url=discord.gg/XvpvYdAR8b style=button] Join to our Discord! [/url]

See you later!
